title: Trimble Appoints Matthew C. Brown to Board of Directors

body_markdown:
*Veteran software and cybersecurity CFO strengthens financial and strategic oversight as Trimble accelerates its Connect & Scale strategy*


WESTMINSTER, Colo.


, Nov. 19, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Trimble (Nasdaq: TRMB) has appointed Matthew C. Brown to its Board of Directors and Audit Committee, effective November 2.


A seasoned financial executive with extensive CFO experience across public technology and software companies like Tenable and Altair Engineering, Brown brings deep expertise in operational scaling, cloud and cybersecurity. His appointment strengthens the Board's financial controls and regulatory compliance oversight as Trimble accelerates its Connect & Scale strategy and embeds AI capabilities across its industry platform ecosystems.


"As a platform company, disciplined capital allocation and cybersecurity execution are essential," said Rob Painter, president and CEO of Trimble. "Matt brings a strategic perspective that is invaluable as we scale our platforms and combine physical ground truth with trusted data to deliver operational confidence."


Trimble's evolution is anchored in bridging the physical and digital worlds to unify people, data, workflows and ecosystems. Brown's addition to the Audit Committee supports Trimble's commitment to drive high-quality recurring revenue growth and balanced capital deployment, while ensuring enterprise-grade data security and sovereignty for global customers managing high-stakes infrastructure.


"Trimble occupies a unique position at the intersection of both hardware and software technologies, providing the vital ground truth data and intelligence that keep essential industries moving forward with confidence," said Brown. "I am excited to join the Board and work with Trimble's leadership team to help advance the company's platform evolution and deliver long-term shareholder value."


Earlier in his career, Brown held other finance and accounting leadership roles in the technology sector. He holds a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Berkeley, Haas School of Business and is a Certified Public Accountant.


**About Trimble**


Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. With relentless innovation in precise positioning, modeling and data analytics, Trimble enables essential industries including construction, geospatial and transportation. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress.
